cases.label: Starting a New Roblox Game Project

forbidden_tools.why: Adding new gameplay code directly at repo root bypasses the game folder structure and cannot be installed into another game.
Flipping shared games/.active without game new corrupts the active game pointer for every other session.

initialize a new game folder with Rojo setup and runtime sync check

cases.label: Inventory, Shop, Quest, Progression, Round, NPC, Data System
required_tools_ordered: Config + pure Rules (no game:GetService/Instance.new, plain {X,Y,Z}) + Service + Controller + spec (incl. hostile cases)
parallax test + parallax fuzz (0 crashes) + parallax mutate (>=80%, V4 target >=90%)

forbidden_tools.why: Putting game logic in untestable Service instead of pure Rules blocks mutation testing and makes hostile-case coverage impossible.
Calling game:GetService in src/shared breaks the shared-pure gate and makes modules dependent on the Roblox runtime.
Shipping green unit tests without Studio playtest misses runtime errors that only appear in a live Roblox place.
Leaking per-player tables on PlayerRemoving causes memory growth and eventual server crashes.

implement a shop data system with mutation testing at 80% and Studio proof

cases.label: Any Client-to-Server RemoteEvent / RemoteFunction

forbidden_tools.why: Hand-wired OnServerEvent without RateLimit + Guard.* lets any client send arbitrary data to the server.
Trusting client-sent position/damage/price/ownership values allows trivial exploits.
Server InvokeClient can hang indefinitely if the client never responds, deadlocking the server thread.
FireAllClients in loops produces network spikes that exceed Roblox remote bandwidth limits.

cases.capability_policy: Full-capability, case-matched execution (NEVER artificially minimal): use the ENTIRE pipeline whenever the piece benefits from it; `required_tools_ordered` is the quality floor, extra non-forbidden pipeline tools are ALWAYS allowed, `forbidden_tools` blocks ONLY tools that degrade this case, and edge-case skips require `--skip-tool <tool> --why "<reason>"` logged to `.verify/parallax_session.json`.

anti_patterns_regex.message: every remote handler validates with Guard + RateLimit — OnServerEvent found without Guard in this file; use parallax net to generate a RateLimit + Guard-checked handler.

examples: add a RemoteEvent for a shop purchase with Guard-checked args and RateLimit
build a network remote for damage reporting with net.json and parallax audit
create a RemoteFunction for inventory sync with bounded Guard validation

cases.label: Combat Abilities, Weapon Attacks, Hitboxes, Cancels
required_tools_ordered: Moves.serve on ONE unified monotonic simulation clock + hitstop accumulator

forbidden_tools.why: Guessing startup/active/recovery frames produces combat that does not match the animation's real timing.
Calling os.clock() inside combat state (Moves.luau) causes split-brain timing where server and client disagree on frame counts.
